name: An Ye zhi Hua
source:
Your pink-haired childhood friend who grew up together actually has an unknown side behind that soft, gentle exterior. What is the reason for the disappearance of the girl who bullied you? And when he confessed his feelings, how would you confront with his intense love?

[Edited from [url=https://wangmumu.itch.io/flower-of-dark-night]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
和你一起长大的粉发青梅竹马，温柔的外表下其实有着不为人知的一面。欺负你的女孩失踪的原因是什么？当他表白自己的感情时，你会如何面对他浓烈的爱呢？

[编辑自[url=https://wangmumu.itch.io/flower-of-dark-night]Itch.io[/url]]
